structured_output.summary: The wiring meets ACC9–ACC13, and the tests cover scoping, raising and lowering, and the default. No existing tests were modified. The remaining notes are advisory.

findings.text: Hiding Content-Length from the app-level limiter means Starlette(max_body_size=N) never fails fast on a declared oversized length. It only rejects after counting bytes, which departs from the fail-fast intent of requirement 1 for the app-level limit.

No test checks that the app-level limit still rejects an oversized declared Content-Length when no inner limit exists. No test checks that user middleware sees the restored Content-Length header. No test covers nested Mounts with different limits, or a Route limit combined with Route middleware.
The _HideContentLength and _RestoreContentLength scope-rewriting pair adds two extra middlewares and a private scope key. It could be replaced with a flag on the limiter or a simpler mechanism.
